x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2015-01-01)
  and date <= (2026-08-31)
  and full text has (
    (
      BEMS
      or stemmed "HVAC flexibility"
      or stemmed "active building"
      or stemmed "building energy management system"
      or stemmed "building thermal flexibility"
      or stemmed "grid-interactive building"
      or stemmed "grid-interactive efficient building"
      or stemmed "smart building"
    )
    and (
      MPC or stemmed "co-optimization" or stemmed "coordinated control"
      or stemmed "distributed control" or stemmed "integrated energy management"
      or stemmed "measurement and verification"
      or stemmed "model predictive control" or stemmed "multi-asset"
      or aggregation or coordination
    )
    and (
      V1G or V2B or V2G or V2H or stemmed "EV fleet"
      or stemmed "electric vehicle" or stemmed "smart charging"
      or stemmed "vehicle-to-building" or stemmed "vehicle-to-grid"
      or stemmed "vehicle-to-home"
    )
    and (
      stemmed "demand response"
      or stemmed "load shifting"
      or stemmed "peak management"
      or stemmed "peak shaving"
      or flexibility
    )
  )
